rev.t: This place offers a pleasant atmosphere with comfortable seating options, perfect for relaxing. 😌 I particularly enjoyed the large screen showing videos, which added to the overall good vibe. It's a nice spot to unwind. 🍻👍 Food was excellent. Great place for a hangout. …

Mannheim offers an amazing ambiance with its indoor and outdoor seating. Outdoor seating is the best. The food is good. Pasta can get better as we found no taste in it. Staff are friendly and helpful. Best part is we were able to see IPL match during our visit on the large screen.

Came here for a corporate team dinner.
The service was quick for most items, and the food tasted good if not exceptional. …
